game_concept: A quiz RPG set in The Kingdom – Library Tower, the royal library tower: the town guard must handle rogue knights while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Swap Switch: Swap two variables with a temporary slot to reroute torches without losing either value.
theme: The Kingdom – Library Tower: the royal library tower
core_gameplay_loop: Read the requested procedure, drag flowchart shapes into the chart, then run checks against example inputs and expected outputs.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Chain 9 consecutive correct decisions about a to power up the town guard and open the town gate.
controls: Drag blocks from the tray into chart positions. Drag them back to remove them. Check chart runs the algorithm. Keyboard: [ or ] selects a block, arrows choose a position, Enter places, C checks, Escape pauses.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: CP1 Week 1: Controls and mission practice
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Swap Switch' (Week 1 slot 4), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Library Tower'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: The Kingdom
region.mood: bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter

code_snippet:
temp = a
a = b
b = temp
tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how a changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against rogue knights in Library Tower.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 9.
